ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Venus and Mars

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on relationships and partnerships. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on home and family. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on your money and what you value. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on your image and your personal energy. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on rest and your inner life. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on friends and plans for the future. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on your career and your goals. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.
